author: Claude (handoff 104)
status: FROZEN. Committed alone, before any implementation, before any window is eligible, and before any fresh outcome exists.
purpose: Freeze the candidate model families, the deterministic preprocessing, the missingness and abstention rules, the hyperparameter grids, the selection procedure and its tie-breaks, the calibration policy, and the comparison against the frozen B11b no-model policies.

feature_contract.binding: the 99 fields, in the frozen feature_order, and nothing else

split_contract.purge_rule: label_window_end_slot + purge_slots < first evaluation slot of the fold
split_contract.group_spanning_rule: a group occupying two segments is dropped whole

non_portable_elements: every figure B11b computes on the B11a window

eligibility.b11a_eligible_reason: B13F section 0 makes the 99-field contract ineligible for B11a permanently: B11a's maturity conditions and unlock evidence were written for a no-model baseline over a 17-field t0 contract. Introducing a 99-field vector there evaluates something nobody preregistered.
eligibility.fitting_permitted_when: a fresh window is named that is disjoint from every burned range AND from B11a, carries its own split plan under the B14a contract, and is added to eligible_windows by an explicit superseding preregistration

target.name: profitable_at_horizon_after_costs
target.definition: net_pnl_lamports > 0 at the primary horizon under the frozen cost policy, for rows whose outcome bucket is marked_at_horizon
target.threshold_provenance: zero is the break-even point defined by the cost policy, not a value selected from any outcome distribution. No quantile, rank or cohort-relative cutoff is used.
target.label_semantics: B10c STATE_IN_FORCE, inherited unchanged from B11b
target.censored_rows: excluded under B14a X01_label_not_observed; never recoded as false, zero or loss

candidate_families.description: predicts the training-fold base rate for every row
candidate_families.fitted_parameters: one exact rational: positives over evaluable training rows
candidate_families.role: degenerate reference. If a family cannot beat it, the family learned nothing, and reporting it makes that visible instead of arguable.

candidate_families.description: one feature, one threshold, one direction; two leaves
candidate_families.fitted_parameters: feature index, integer or rational threshold, direction, two exact rational leaf values
candidate_families.role: the simplest model that can use a feature at all; the honest floor for 'the vector carries signal'

candidate_families.description: axis-aligned binary tree, exact rational Gini impurity, integer or rational thresholds, exact rational leaf values
candidate_families.fitted_parameters: tree structure, thresholds, leaf values, per-node null direction
candidate_families.role: bounded interaction structure while remaining exactly representable and fully auditable

candidate_families.description: additive stumps over exact rational residuals, quantised to the declared fixed denominator after every round
candidate_families.fitted_parameters: ordered stump list with quantised rational leaf increments
candidate_families.grid_note: shrinkage is one rational, not two independent axes, so the grid is enumerated explicitly rather than as a cross product. A cross product over the numerator and denominator lists would silently be size 8 and would include shrinkages nobody preregistered.
candidate_families.role: the one family with capacity beyond a shallow tree, bounded hard so its capacity is declared rather than discovered

excluded_families.reason: real-valued coefficients are not exactly representable; the same fit serialises differently on two machines, so two identical models hash differently and two different models can hash the same
same float objection, plus no bounded declaration of capacity is possible in a grid this size
float coefficients; kernel choice is an undeclarable capacity knob
bagging randomness multiplies the seed surface without adding auditability over F3/F4 at these depths
the fitted object is the training set itself; a distance metric over 99 heterogeneous integer scales is an undeclared weighting
selecting a configuration and then averaging it with the runners-up is selection twice, and the second is unpriced

a monotone direction per feature is a directional hypothesis, and we have no basis for one that was not obtained by looking at outcomes. Deferred, not refused: admissible only under a superseding preregistration that states each direction and its prior justification.

arithmetic.representation: integers and gcd-reduced rationals as named integer numerator/denominator pairs
arithmetic.quantisation_rule: round half to even against the fixed denominator, applied after every boosting round so denominators cannot grow without bound
arithmetic.impurity: exact rational Gini; no float comparison at any split
arithmetic.comparison_rule: rationals compared by integer cross-multiplication only

preprocessing.note: Every rule here is either fold-free or fitted on training folds of the bound split plan only. Nothing is fitted on validation, calibration-holdout or test.
preprocessing.feature_selection: none. All 99 fields are offered to every family; a family that ignores a field does so by fitting, not by a selection step that saw the data first.

rational_pair_handling.rule: a numerator/denominator pair is ONE feature of rational type. A split compares the exact rational by integer cross-multiplication. A split on a numerator alone is refused: a numerator without its denominator is not a quantity.
rational_pair_handling.zero_denominator_rule: a pair whose denominator is zero is null for that row, never zero; the share does not exist

preprocessing.threshold_candidate_rule: candidate split points are the midpoints between consecutive DISTINCT values observed in the TRAINING FOLDS ONLY, expressed exactly as rationals. Deriving candidates from all rows would let the evaluation fold choose where the model may cut.

missingness.principle: unavailable is not zero, and no value is ever imputed
missingness.row_level: a row whose feature vector is unavailable under B13F V01-V07 produces no training row and no prediction; at inference it abstains under A01

field_level.rule: a null in a governed optional field is routed down a dedicated third branch at each node; the branch direction is fitted on training folds only
field_level.note: the availability flags are fields 70 and 93 of the frozen contract, so the model can see 'we cannot say' as itself rather than inferring it from a substituted number

missingness.refusal_reason: a zero claims the thing did not happen, a median claims this subject was typical and is fitted on a distribution, and a missingness encoding chosen because it improved a score is the outcome entering through the door marked handling missing data

selection.test_fold_rule: the test fold is scored exactly once, with exactly one configuration, after the selected configuration's artifact hash has been recorded
selection.cross_validation: walk-forward only. No k-fold shuffling, no repeated CV, no re-use of any evaluation row.

primary_metric.name: brier_score_exact_rational
primary_metric.computation: summed as one rational over a common denominator, never a mean of rounded terms
primary_metric.justification: it is a proper scoring rule, so it cannot be improved by miscalibration; it is threshold-free, so no decision threshold is chosen during selection; and it is exactly computable as a rational.

forbidden_selection_metrics.name: realised_capital_weighted_return
forbidden_selection_metrics.reason: selecting on realised return over a validation fold selects the configuration that happened to catch that fold's few largest winners

forbidden_selection_metrics.name: any_metric_requiring_a_decision_threshold
forbidden_selection_metrics.reason: the threshold becomes a second, unpriced selection

forbidden_selection_metrics.name: any_metric_computed_on_the_test_fold
forbidden_selection_metrics.reason: that is not selection, it is fitting to the answer

tie_breaks_in_strict_order: 1. lower exact Brier on the validation folds
3. lower family index in the frozen order F1 < F2 < F3 < F4
4. lower grid index in the frozen enumeration order of that family
selection.tie_break_property: the order is total and deterministic, so no tie is ever resolved at random or by whichever configuration was enumerated first by accident

family_accounting.rule: the model family and the B11b baseline family are counted separately and neither absorbs the other. Any future inferential claim over the model family uses a Bonferroni-corrected alpha of 0.05/60.
family_accounting.no_test_in_this_design: no significance test, confidence interval or p-value is computed. Grouped uncertainty is an assumption-free jackknife spread over the split plan's exact-identity groups.

calibration.is_selectable_reason: making calibration an option doubles the family and invites choosing it because it scored better
calibration.fitted_on: a dedicated calibration sub-fold, chronologically last within the training segment and disjoint from the fitting sub-folds
never_fitted_on: any fold used to fit the model
calibration.never_fitted_on_reason: a probability calibrated on the evaluation fold is calibrated against the answer; B14a I10 refuses it and this states the same rule where a reader will look for it

excluded_methods.reason: the edges are a fitted choice and B14b already requires preregistered edges naming their folds

abstention.principle: an abstention is a declared non-decision, counted in the census, deploying no capital. It is never a prediction of the negative class.

codes.condition: the feature vector is unavailable for any B13F reason V01-V07
a rational-pair denominator required by a split on the selected model's path is zero
a feature used by a split on the selected model's path takes a value outside the closed interval observed for it in the training folds
a null arrives at a node whose training folds contained no nulls for that feature, so no null direction was ever fitted
the inference window is not in eligible_windows, which currently means every window

abstention.out_of_distribution_rationale: a tree predicts an out-of-range value from a leaf whose support never contained anything like it. That is an extrapolation the fit never saw, and recording it as an abstention keeps it in the census instead of dressing it as a prediction.
abstention.abstention_rate_rule: no threshold governs the abstention rate, and it may not be adjusted after any result is seen. The rate is reported per code.

leakage_constraints: C01 every transform, threshold candidate set, calibration map and training-range record is fitted on training folds of the bound split plan only
C02 grouping is B14a R5 exact-identity union with creator and user pooled; a group occupying two segments is dropped whole
C03 purge is computed on label_window_end_slot, never on t0
C04 embargo applies after every evaluation segment
C05 chronology is strict: train_last < validation_first <= validation_last < test_first, and touching segments are refused
C06 no absolute slot number is a feature; B13F already excludes them
C07 no identity is a feature under any encoding, including a hash bucket or an embedding
C08 B13b association evidence never enters, as a feature or as a grouping
C09 no cluster artifact is accepted; ACCEPTED_CLUSTER_ARTIFACT_TYPES is empty and the funding-cluster gate stays open
C10 the test fold is touched once, with one configuration, after the selection is hashed
C11 no outcome, label or post-t0 path state is visible to any feature or transform
C12 no threshold, bin edge or cutoff is taken from a burned outcome distribution

comparison_against_b11b.primary_comparator_reason: P1 is the reference the pipeline produces with no selection whatsoever, which is exactly what a selective model must beat to have shown anything
comparison_against_b11b.instantiation_rule: the B11b POLICY DEFINITIONS are re-instantiated on the same eligible window, the same rows and the same split plan as the model. They are rules, carry no fitted parameter and import nothing from B11a.

forbidden_comparison.description: comparing a model scored on a future window against the figures B11b computes on B11a
forbidden_comparison.reason: the two numbers come from different windows, so their difference measures the windows, not the model. Refused by name.

comparison_against_b11b.pairing: B14b paired comparison: exactly the rows where both sides produce an outcome, never a caller-supplied cohort
mandatory_published_figures: every headline on both bases, observed_evaluable and whole_cohort_worst_case
model_evaluable_only and baseline_evaluable_only counts and their difference
model entry count and baseline entry count
grouped jackknife spread over the split plan's exact-identity groups
comparison_against_b11b.entry_count_rationale: a model that abstains heavily can post a better per-position figure while deploying almost nothing. Publishing both entry counts and both bases makes that visible rather than arguable.

evidence_statement.what_would_count_as_evidence: the selected configuration beats P1 on the primary metric on the test fold, on BOTH bases, by more than the grouped jackknife spread
evidence_statement.why_not: no publication threshold is preregistered because nobody here has earned a good-enough line, and the funding-cluster leakage gate remains open regardless of any figure

status_locks.u4_u5: untouched; still require a separate explicit decision after collection

prohibited_in_this_pass: fitting any model on any real data
selecting any threshold from a burned outcome distribution
altering or restarting the live watcher
